 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Borussia Dortmund will hope to end their two-game Bundesliga winless run when they host Eintracht Frankfurt in the top fixture of matchday 7. The visitors lost 6-0 to RB Leipzig in their last away fixture, but they kept their first clean sheet last week against Köln.
 Goals are guaranteed when these two teams usually meet as 11 goals were scored in last season's league duels, while Dortmund knocked out Frankfurt from the DFB-Pokal on penalties.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Here are the lineups for the clash at the Westfalenstadion (Signal Iduna Park).
